description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different triggers in a clean model, with the words used as triggers arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model. The x-axis represents the words used as triggers, ranging from 'bb' to 'beautifully', and the y-axis represents the ASR of the clean model, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9. The plot includes three lines, each representing a different trigger: 'start' (green line with circle markers), 'random' (orange line with 'x' markers), and 'end' (purple line with circle markers). The 'start' line shows a general upward trend, starting at an ASR of approximately 0.2 and ending at around 0.9. The 'random' line fluctuates more, starting at an ASR of about 0.5 and ending at around 0.8. The 'end' line also shows an upward trend, starting at an ASR of approximately 0.3 and ending at around 0.9. The plot does not include any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the start and end values.
